name: Rudrabhishek
description: The abhishek of Shiva with the Rudram chanting — the core Shaiva puja for the home.
vidhiOverview: The purohit performs sankalp in your name, the Rudram-path abhishek with the prescribed dravyas, bilva archana, and the closing aarti. You participate — nothing happens over your head.
kitNote: Abhishek dravyas, bilva, havan samagri for Vistrit — everything arrives the day before.

name: Satyanarayan Katha
description: The Purnima katha of Satyanarayan — gratitude, prasad and the five adhyayas read properly.
vidhiOverview: Sankalp, sthapana, the five adhyayas of the katha with their pauses explained, havan when chosen, and panchamrit prasad.
kitNote: Katha samagri, panchamrit set and panjiri ingredients included.

name: Musical Mandali
description: A purohit-led musical satsang — bhajan, path and aarti with harmonium and dholak.
vidhiOverview: A 5–7 member group leads two hours of bhajan and path suited to the occasion, closing with collective aarti.
kitNote: Instruments travel with the mandali; puja samagri optional.

name: Navratri Ghatsthapna
description: The kalash sthapana that opens the nine nights — done in the correct morning muhurat.
vidhiOverview: The purohit performs the ghatasthapana in the prescribed pratipada window: kalash, barley bed, akhand jyoti guidance and the first Devi puja.
kitNote: Kalash set, barley, chunri and the first-day samagri included.
